title.narrative: Improving the protection environment of Rohingya refugees relocated to Bhasan Char

description.narrative: Contract related to: Improving the protection environment of Rohingya refugees relocated to Bhasan Char - The action will strive to improve the overall protection environment in Bhasan Char Island by ensuring that the Rohingya refugees relocated to the island are protected and can live in safety and dignity until a durable solution is achieved. The action will focus on preventing and responding to sexual and gender-based violence. It will strengthen the protective environment of children and monitore the willingness of refugees to relocate. It will also improve the provision of essential health services.
